teacherOversight.auditBody: Append-only. Every administrative action against this teacher is here, with what it changed.

payouts.title: Payouts & disbursement
payouts.subtitle: Approving debits the wallet, writes a ledger entry, and marks the request paid — in one irreversible step.
payouts.empty: No payout requests in this filter
payouts.emptyBody: Change the filter above, or generate month-end payouts.
payouts.loadErrorBody: No response from the server. Nothing in the ledger changed.
payouts.panelEmptyBody: The computation and the approve button appear here once you pick a request from the list.
payouts.clearanceOk: No pending refunds against this beneficiary, and the wallet balance covers the full amount.
payouts.clearanceBlocked: The wallet balance does not cover this amount. Approving will fail and no entry will be written.
payouts.lockNotice: Approval is final: the amount is debited from the wallet and the entry is written to a ledger that accepts no edit or delete. The only correction afterwards is a new reversing entry.
payouts.commitHint: Two steps: the first press arms the button, the second writes the entry.
payouts.commitArmedHint: The entry will be written in your name to the audit log and cannot be undone.
payouts.commitAnnounce: Button armed. Press again to confirm disbursement permanently.
payouts.rejectPlaceholder: Write a reason that can be explained to the beneficiary
payouts.rejectRequired: A reason is required — a rejection with no reason cannot be explained to anyone.
payouts.rejectHint: Rejecting releases the reserved amount back to the available balance.
payouts.approveOk: Approved — a second person now records the transfer
payouts.rejectOk: Rejection recorded and the reserved amount released
payouts.deniedTitle: This screen is for platform admins
payouts.deniedBody: Your account is not permitted to view payout requests.
payouts.receiptLoadFailed: Couldn't load the receipt. Please try again.
payouts.payOk: Paid and written to the ledger
payouts.payRefRequired: A transfer reference is required — a payment with no reference cannot be reconciled.
payouts.payHint: Money moves on this step. Whoever approved or generated the payout cannot record it; the reference must be unique.

walletPolicy.subtitle: Bounds on a SINGLE top-up, checked server-side before any money is taken — online (Paymob) and center cash alike.

walletPolicy.boundsSubtitle: Applied to every student on every top-up channel.
walletPolicy.minHint: Keeps dust amounts off the payment gateway. Currently:
walletPolicy.maxHint: A typo guard on a single charge — not a limit on total balance. Currently:
walletPolicy.applyNote: Changes apply to the next top-up; intents already created keep the amount they were validated at.
walletPolicy.savedOk: Wallet policy saved — the next top-up uses the new bounds
walletPolicy.orderError: Maximum top-up cannot be lower than the minimum

commissionSettings.readOnlyNote: These are the rates the ledger numbers are built from. Changing them is a super-admin action.
commissionSettings.globalSubtitle: Applied to every teacher and center without a specific override.
commissionSettings.pctHint: Platform share of every teacher-direct subscription payment with no center involved. Applied at charge time; already-settled payments keep the rate they were charged at.
commissionSettings.feesHint: Flat per-present-student fees on the center-course session split.
commissionSettings.savedOk: Commission settings saved — new charges use the new rates immediately
commissionSettings.forwardOnly: The change applies to future charges only and touches no entry already written.

roomSettlements.title: Room settlements
roomSettlements.subtitle: A settlement record per session, written by the money engine in the same transaction as the ledger, exactly once per session.
roomSettlements.mismatchNote: The mismatch flag means attendance was edited AFTER the money settled. The ledger is final; corrections go through a refund or an adjusting entry.
roomSettlements.emptyBody: A settlement appears here as soon as the first session completes.
roomSettlements.deniedBody: Your account is not permitted to view settlements.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.subtitle: Every back-office action, in order, with before and after state.
auditLog.appendOnlyBody: The database revokes UPDATE and DELETE on this table for the application role, so an entry cannot be edited or removed from any app surface — including by a super admin.
auditLog.emptyBody: Widen the search or clear the filters above.
auditLog.loadError: Could not load the audit log
auditLog.deniedBody: Your account is not permitted to view the audit log.

oversight.appendOnlyBody: Every ledger on this page is history and cannot be edited or deleted — the database revokes UPDATE and DELETE on the transaction and points ledgers for the application role, super admins included. The actions below ADD to it through the real flows (recorded payment, wallet top-up, walk-in subscription, payout request); nothing anywhere rewrites a past row or sets a balance directly.
oversight.noLedgerRows: No ledger rows for this center.
oversight.refundFlagNote: “Mark refunded” on a payment is a STATUS FLAG — it writes no ledger reversal and returns no money. Use the finance refund flow to actually return money; it is limited to one refund per payment.
oversight.walletScopeNote: Student wallet movements credited at this center (cash top-ups taken at its counter). Spending elsewhere belongs to that other center's books.
oversight.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded in the audit log alongside who, what and when.
oversight.actionDone: Done — the action was recorded in the audit log
oversight.headerDesc: Full read visibility across this center, plus a fixed set of audited control actions. Financial records are visible but never editable here.
oversight.deactivateBody: Its center-admin accounts are suspended with it, and every live session is cut on the next request. Courses, enrollments, rosters and all financial history are left untouched — reactivating restores access exactly.
oversight.activateBody: Its center-admin accounts are reactivated with it and can sign in again.
oversight.editableBody: Identity and contact details only. The wallet balance, receipt sequence, short ID and account status are not editable from this form — and neither are the revenue split or commission percentages, which keep their own pricing screen so a money-sensitive number never has two edit paths.
oversight.profileSaved: Profile updated — recorded in the audit log
oversight.auditTitle: Every control action on this center
oversight.auditBody: Who did it, what changed (before and after), and when. The audit table itself is append-only at the database level — it cannot be edited or erased from here.
oversight.approveQ: Approve on behalf of the platform?
oversight.rejectQ: Reject on behalf of the platform?
oversight.approveBody: Creates the affiliation, the course, its sessions and the frozen pricing snapshot in one transaction. Both the teacher and the center are notified that the platform decided.
oversight.approveMethodNote: This hall offers both pricing methods and the teacher never chose one. Approving here applies whole-room %.
oversight.rejectBody: The request is closed and both sides are notified with the reason. No course or schedule is created.
oversight.pf_noCenterCanBody: They exist for platform support, so each one is narrow and says what it will not do. Moving a course between centers is deliberately not offered — its pricing was frozen from this center and its sessions have settled here.
oversight.pf_moveStudent: Move a student to another center
oversight.pf_rosterOnlyBody: Enrollments, subscriptions, payments and wallet history stay at this center.
oversight.pf_onRoster: The student is now on the destination center's roster.
oversight.pf_logoutBody: Kills every live session on the account's next request. It changes no status and deletes nothing — the person can sign straight back in. If you mean to stop them using the platform, deactivate the account instead.
oversight.pf_logoutOk: Every live session for that account is now dead
oversight.pf_dobBody2: unless a verified date of birth shows 18 or over, and parent oversight of their conversations is active for every minor.
oversight.pf_yearsOldAdult: years old — verifying this makes them an adult, and their parent will no longer be able to see their conversations with staff and teachers.
oversight.pf_yearsOldMinor: years old — still a minor, so parent oversight stays on.
oversight.pf_dobOk: Date of birth verified — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ma_realFlows: These are the real flows, not ledger edits
oversight.ma_realFlowsBody: Each one writes through the money engine with a receipt or reference number, exactly as the center's own counter does. None of them edits a ledger row or sets a balance — those stay impossible, for a super admin too.
oversight.ma_creditOnlyBody: There is no counter-side withdrawal anywhere in the product — money goes in here, and only the student's own spending or a refund takes it out.
oversight.ma_walkInNote: The charge is the course's configured plan price — there is no amount field, so no number can be entered here.
oversight.ma_amountFull: Amount (EGP — blank means the full balance)
oversight.ma_subscriptionOk: Subscription created and paid in cash
oversight.ma_payoutNote: This pays nothing. It raises a pending payout; approval and settlement stay with the accountant, where the balance floor is enforced.
oversight.ma_recordCashNote: Writes a Payment with a center receipt number and a mirrored ledger entry, in one transaction. Positive amounts only — returning money is the refund flow.
oversight.ma_paymentOk: Payment recorded — receipt issued and mirrored to the ledger
oversight.ma_topUpOk: Wallet topped up — receipt issued and mirrored to the ledger
oversight.ma_payoutOk: Payout requested — pending the accountant's approval
oversight.op_settledLockedBody: Once a session has been settled its revenue is already distributed, so it can no longer be cancelled, moved, or completed again. Completing a session is the one action on this screen that writes to the ledger — it always shows a preview first.
oversight.op_writesToLedgerBody: It runs the same settlement the teacher's own “complete” runs, at the rates frozen onto this course when it was created. It happens exactly once — a settled session cannot be settled again.
oversight.op_correctNoMoney: Correcting a settled session does not move money
oversight.op_correctNoMoneyBody: The attendance record is the truth about a student, so it can always be corrected. But if the session has already settled, the settlement is NOT recomputed — that would re-rate a distributed lesson. The divergence from the settled headcount is written into the audit log instead of being discovered later.
oversight.op_softDeleteBody: The account is marked deleted and its live session is cut on the next request, but the row survives — so payments, settlements and every ledger reference to that person stay resolvable. Nothing financial is erased.
oversight.op_financialPreserved3: — nothing in the ledger is removed or rewritten.
oversight.op_accountSoftDeleted: The account is soft-deleted and loses access on its very next request.
oversight.op_accountKeepsWorking: The account keeps working. Your note is recorded.
oversight.op_nobodyBlocked: Nobody is blocked at this center.
oversight.op_attendanceCorrected: Attendance corrected — recorded in the audit log
oversight.op_sessionCompleted: Session completed — revenue distributed and recorded in the audit log
oversight.op_sessionPostponed: Session postponed — students notified, recorded in the audit log
oversight.pp_staffNoPassword: Staff never receive a password from anyone
oversight.pp_staffNoPasswordBody: A new staff account is created as a shell and emailed a single-use claim link — the person sets their own credential. Re-sending is refused once they have.
oversight.pp_accessCut: Access is cut on their next request. Enrollments are kept.
oversight.pp_canSignInAgain: The account can sign in again immediately.
oversight.pp_removeFromRosterQ: Remove this student from the roster?
oversight.pp_studentUpdated: Student updated — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_frozenTitle: The pricing snapshot is frozen and not editable
oversight.ac_frozenBody: A course's pricing method and revenue split were frozen when it was created, from the platform pricing configuration — settlement reads them, so changing one would re-rate a live course. They are shown here and edited nowhere. The hall cannot be swapped for the same reason: a different hall means a new class.
oversight.ac_hallPriceTitle: Hall price is not a revenue share
oversight.ac_hallPriceBody: The price here is what the center shows teachers when booking. The revenue split and the per-student rate are platform pricing configuration and live on their own screen.
oversight.ac_enrolNote1: Enrolling creates the roster link only — it does
oversight.ac_enrolNote3: create a subscription, so it does not hand out paid coverage. Unenrolling refunds nothing.
oversight.ac_newTeacher: New teacher (must be affiliated with this center)
oversight.ac_studentNotified: The student is notified with your reason.
oversight.ac_courseCreated: Course created — schedule generated, recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_courseUpdated: Course updated — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_studentEnrolled: Student enrolled — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_teacherReassigned: Teacher reassigned — recorded in the audit log
oversight.pp_teacherLosesAccess: They lose access on their next request. Courses, schedules and all financial history are untouched.
oversight.pp_affiliationEnds: Their affiliation ends. Refused while they have active courses here — cancel or reassign those first.
oversight.collabCreateNote: For a teacher who ALREADY has an account — the invite button next to this one is shell-account onboarding and refuses one. This lands as a pending request: the teacher is notified, and only their acceptance creates the affiliation, course, schedule and pricing snapshot. No rate is entered here — every rate is superadmin config, and on a hall offering both pricing methods the teacher picks when accepting.
oversight.collabTeacherSearch: Search by name, email or phone
oversight.collabNoTeachers: No active teacher matches this search.
oversight.collabNoOfferings: This subject is not offered for any year yet — add an offering in the catalog first.
oversight.collabHallNote: Booking a hall applies its revenue split. On a hall offering both pricing methods, the teacher picks the method when accepting.
oversight.collabSentToast: Collaboration request sent — waiting for the teacher to accept.
oversight.collabBadTimes: The end time must be after the start time.
oversight.ac_cancelCourseBody1: Future sessions are cancelled and {count, plural, one {# enrolled student is} other {# enrolled students are}} notified with your reason.
oversight.ac_cancelCourseBody2: This refunds nothing and cancels no subscription. Sessions that already settled are untouched — use the refund flow for money.
oversight.ac_courseCreateNote: The teacher must already have an active affiliation with this center. Picking a hall freezes that hall's pricing method and rate onto the course — permanently.
oversight.ac_editCourseNote: Plan prices set what a NEW subscription costs. Existing subscriptions keep the price they were bought at, and the course's frozen revenue split never changes.
oversight.ac_reassignNote: Only future sessions move to the new teacher. Past sessions keep theirs — they record who actually taught, and some may already have been settled to that person.
oversight.ac_unenrolBody: The record survives with an unenrolled date, so the history stays readable. Nothing is refunded.
oversight.ac_enrolDialogNote: Refused if the student is blacklisted at platform, center or teacher level, or if the course is not this center's.
oversight.ac_requestsNote: Approving creates the enrollment and notifies the student. Refused when the course is full or the request has expired — the same rules the center is held to.
oversight.ac_approveRequestBody: Creates the enrollment and notifies the student. No subscription is created — this grants a seat, not paid coverage.
oversight.ac_deactivateHallBody: Soft — never a delete, so its sessions and settlement records keep resolving.
oversight.op_cancelSessionBody: Students are notified. Refused if the session has already been settled.
oversight.op_nonePresent: No students are marked present — settling now distributes nothing. Check the attendance first.
oversight.op_postponeNote: Checked against the teacher's and the hall's other bookings. Refused if the session has already been settled.
oversight.op_correctedDiverged: Corrected — but this session was already settled, so the attendance no longer matches the settled headcount. The settlement was NOT recomputed; the divergence is in the audit log.
oversight.op_broadcastNote: Goes to this center's enrolled students (and their parents for a course broadcast). It is sent as the platform, not as the center.
oversight.op_broadcastSent: {count, plural, one {Sent to # recipient} other {Sent to # recipients}}
oversight.op_blacklistNote: A center-level block withdraws that student's enrollments at this center only, through the reversible cascade journal — lifting it restores exactly those rows.
oversight.op_liftBody: The cascade journal is replayed: exactly the enrollments this block withdrew are restored, and nothing else.
oversight.pp_rosterNote: The same roster the center manages. Removing from the roster keeps every enrollment — withdrawing enrollments is the separate, reversible action below.
oversight.pp_removeRosterBody1: They leave the center's roster. This is the center's own removal — it does not withdraw enrollments and refunds nothing.
oversight.pp_removeRosterBody2: To withdraw enrollments reversibly, use “Remove from center” on the Students control row instead.
oversight.pp_inviteStudentNote: Creates a shell account on this center's roster and emails an activation link. An already-registered email is refused.
oversight.pp_addExistingNote: Adds an already-registered student account to this center's roster by their user id.
oversight.pp_teacherRemoveNote: Removing a teacher is refused while they still have active courses here — the same rule the center is held to.
oversight.pp_inviteTeacherNote: Shell-account onboarding only. A teacher who already has an account is refused here — send them a collaboration request instead.
oversight.pp_resendBody: Mints a fresh single-use link. Refused if this person has already set a password — that is what the reset flow is for.
oversight.pp_removeStaffBody: Their link is soft-removed, so their access ends on the next request and the history of what they did is kept.
oversight.pp_staffAdded: Staff member added — claim link emailed
oversight.pp_accountantReadOnly: {role} is read-only — it can view this center's financial reports and nothing else.
oversight.pp_removeAdminBody: Refused if they are the last admin — a center can never be left without an owner.
oversight.pp_inviteAdminNote: Emails an invite to become a co-owner of this center.
oversight.rp_ownReportingBody: These are the same aggregations the center sees on its portal, read for this center. Every figure is derived — nothing on this tab writes.
oversight.pf_stayedNote: These are facts about what happened here, and some have already settled — they are never moved. Enrol the student at the new center as a new arrival.
oversight.pp_barQ: Bar this student from the centre?
oversight.pp_barBody: A centre blacklist is written and the student's active enrolments here are cancelled. It can be undone by readmitting them.
oversight.pp_readmitBody: The centre blacklist is lifted and the enrolments it cancelled are restored.
oversight.op_noAttendees: No one is enrolled in this session.

centersAdmin.noRooms: This center has no active rooms.

security.revokeFailed: Could not sign out the device
security.statusLoadFailed: Could not load your two-factor status

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.subtitle: Every account on the platform, whatever their role. Search by name, email or phone.
adminUsers.emptyBody: No account matches this search and these filters. Try a wider search.
adminUsers.deniedBody: Only a super admin can view the user directory.
adminUsers.recordSubtitle: Identity, live sessions, and the operations available on this account.
adminUsers.actionsDesc: Every operation here is written to the audit log with its reason. Nothing here touches money.
adminUsers.sessionsDesc: Every device currently signed in to this account.
adminUsers.reasonHint: The reason is stored in the audit log — it is the only lasting record of why.
adminUsers.confirm_suspend_body: The account stops working immediately and every live session ends. It can be reinstated at any time.
adminUsers.confirm_reinstate_body: The account becomes active again and its owner can sign in as before.
adminUsers.confirm_revokeAll_body: Every live session ends. The account is NOT suspended — its owner can sign back in with the same password.
adminUsers.confirm_reset2fa_body: The authenticator enrollment is cleared and every session ends. A back-office account must enroll again at the next sign-in.
adminUsers.confirm_passwordReset_body: The account receives a link and chooses its own new password. You never see or set it.
adminUsers.confirm_impersonate_title: View the app as this account?
adminUsers.confirm_impersonate_body: Your session becomes theirs until you stop, and both the start and the stop are audited. Only back-office accounts can be viewed this way.
adminUsers.impersonatingAs: You are viewing the back office as {name}
adminUsers.confirm_reissueCard_body: Every card previously printed for this student stops working immediately and the new one becomes current. This also lifts any existing stop on the card.
adminUsers.confirm_revokeCard_body: The card cannot record attendance until it is reissued. The student's account, code and subscriptions are unaffected.

card.title: Student ID card
card.subtitle: Loaded only when opened; viewing it is recorded in the audit log.
card.reissueHint: Reissuing invalidates every previously printed card. The student's code itself never changes — subscriptions, attendance and receipts all key on it.
card.pendingCode: This student has not finished onboarding, so their code is provisional and no card is printed.
card.unavailable: The card could not be loaded.
card.failed: The action could not be completed

adminUsers.actionViewAs: Open the ERP as this user
adminUsers.confirm_viewAs_title: Open the ERP as this user?
adminUsers.confirm_viewAs_body: A one-hour session opens in a new tab with this user's full access — including money actions such as payments, wallets and refunds. Start and end are recorded in the audit log against your account, and a banner names you on every screen. Your back-office session here stays signed in.
adminUsers.viewAsNoHandoff: The server did not return a valid hand-off — nothing was opened. Try again.
adminUsers.viewAsPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.
adminUsers.confirm_blacklist_body: The account is disabled platform-wide and its active enrolments are cancelled. The entry stays on the Blacklist screen, where it can be lifted.

featureFlags.title: Feature flags
featureFlags.subtitle: Platform-wide switches. Every change is written to the audit log.
featureFlags.defaultClosedBody: A key with no row in the database reads as disabled. A typo'd key or an unseeded database ends at “not available”, never at exposing something that isn't ready.
featureFlags.emptyBody: No flag is defined in code or stored in the database.

contactInbox.title: Contact inbox
contactInbox.subtitle: Messages received through the public site's contact form.
contactInbox.readOnlyNotice: Read-only — no message text or sender detail can be edited here. Only the triage status can change.
contactInbox.emptyBody: Nothing has arrived that matches the current filters.

deletionQueue.title: Account deletion requests
deletionQueue.subtitle: Personal-data deletion requests under Egypt's Law 151/2020.
deletionQueue.ledgerNotice: Approving erases personal details only (name, email, phone, guardian contact). Financial records — payments, receipts, settlements — remain exactly as they are, without a name, because the law requires us to keep them and because they cannot be edited in the first place.
deletionQueue.subject: Account holder
deletionQueue.approveConfirmBody: The account is disabled immediately and its personal details are permanently erased. Erasure cannot be undone.
deletionQueue.rejectConfirmBody: The account keeps its personal details. The account holder is told the request was rejected, so write the reason plainly.
deletionQueue.approvedOk: Request executed and personal details erased
deletionQueue.notAnonymized: Account disabled but personal details not yet erased

tour.title: A quick tour of the back office

welcome.title: Welcome 👋 this is the platform back office
welcome.body: From here you see every centre, every teacher and every pound on the platform. This tour is ordered by consequence rather than by the menu: what unblocks work first, then what touches money, then what touches people. It also tells you what you may NOT do from here.

registrations.title: 1. Registrations — nothing runs until these are approved
registrations.body: A centre or teacher who signs up stays “under review” until you approve. Before that they cannot operate.

how.2: Open the request and check its details

registrations.note: Rejecting closes the account immediately. A pending request can do nothing at all, so don't leave one waiting without a reason.

users.title: 2. Users — the only door for disabling an account
users.body: Every user on the platform in one place: suspend, reinstate, or end sessions.

how.3: Open the user and choose the action

users.note: Suspending ends every session on that account in the same moment. And you never see or set anyone's password — you send a reset link and they set it themselves.

centers.title: 3. A centre's books — read-only
centers.body: Open any centre and see all of it: students, teachers, lessons, and all six money ledgers.

how.3: Move between the tabs: operations, money, staff, audit

centers.note: Rows with no centre (an independent teacher) are never folded into a centre's books — so if a figure isn't showing under a centre, that's usually why.

moneyReadOnly.title: 4. Money here is read, never moved
moneyReadOnly.body: The most important thing to know about this console: you see every pound and you move none of them.

how.2: Look at the payment, its receipt and the entries it wrote
how.3: If something is wrong, the correction happens at the centre or as a new entry — never by editing the old one

moneyReadOnly.note: This is enforced by the database, not the interface: UPDATE and DELETE on the money ledger and the audit log are refused **for this role too**. So even a compromised console cannot erase an entry.

payouts.title: 5. Payouts and disbursement
payouts.body: Teachers' and centres' withdrawal requests come through here.

how.2: Check the request, the amount and the available balance
how.3: Approve it, and mark it disbursed after the real transfer

payouts.note: The amount is reserved from the moment of the request — which is why a teacher's “available” drops before you have paid anything.

settlements.title: 6. Room settlements
settlements.body: The centre's share of each lesson, computed from the room's own settings.

how.3: Compare it against the room's percentage or per-student rate

commission.title: 7. Commission — the one number you set
commission.body: The platform's share of every lesson. It's a global setting, and it can be specialised per centre.

how.3: Or set a specific rate for one centre

commission.note: A change applies to NEW classes only. An existing class keeps the rate it was created with — so nobody finds their revenue changed retroactively.

catalog.title: 8. The education catalog
catalog.body: Systems, stages, grades, tracks and subjects — what every student's choices are built from.

how.2: Move between system, stage and grade
how.3: Review the subjects attached to each track

catalog.note: This is permanent reference data, not demo data — editing it changes what every new student sees.

messaging.title: 9. Messaging — and opening a thread is recorded
messaging.body: You can search the log, open any thread, and work the reports and blocks queue.

how.3: Open a thread to read it

messaging.note: Opening a thread writes a row to the audit log in your name. That's deliberate: reading people's conversations should leave a trace like any other action.

audit.title: 10. The audit log
audit.body: Every sensitive action on the platform: who did it, to whom, and when.

how.2: Filter by actor, action type or centre

audit.note: This log cannot be edited or deleted — not by you, not by any role. That's what makes it evidence rather than notes.

deletion.title: 11. Account deletion requests
deletion.body: A user who asked for their account to be deleted is waiting on your review.

how.2: Open the request and read the reason
how.3: Check whether the account carries financial obligations

deletion.note: Deletion does not erase financial records — those are the centre's obligations. What is erased is the personal data.

security.title: 12. Your own account's security
security.body: This is the most powerful account on the platform, so its security isn't optional.

how.2: Review the devices signed into your account
how.3: End any session you don't recognise

security.note: Two-factor is mandatory on your account — without it not a single screen opens. It isn't a setting you can turn off.

finish.title: That's it — your turn 🎉
finish.body: The tour is done. Start with “Registrations” — that's what lets centres operate. And remember: money here is read, and the audit log sees you exactly as it sees everyone else.

financeTour.title: A quick tour of the finance console

welcome.title: Welcome 👋 this is the finance console
welcome.body: Your account is scoped to money — no centres, no users, no catalog, deliberately. This tour follows the money itself: what comes in, what goes out, and the rate between them. It also tells you what you read without being able to change it.

payments.title: 1. Money in
payments.body: Every payment on the platform — online or cash — with its receipt and the entries it wrote.

how.3: Open a payment to see its receipt and its entries

payments.note: Cash and online are written to the same ledger with the same entries — so don't go looking for a second set of books.

subscriptions.title: 2. Subscriptions
subscriptions.body: What sits behind each payment: who subscribed to what, monthly or single-lesson, and how long it runs.

how.2: Check the plan, the amount and the period
how.3: Compare against the payment if something needs explaining

payouts.title: 3. Money out — this is the daily work
payouts.body: Teachers and centres request their earnings, and you review and approve.

how.2: Check the request, the amount and the available balance
how.3: Approve or reject — rejecting returns the amount to their available balance
how.4: You can approve a batch of requests at once

payouts.note: The amount is reserved from the moment of the request, which is why a teacher's “available” drops before anything is paid. The actual transfer happens outside the platform — you mark that it was made.

refunds.title: 4. Refunds
refunds.body: If a lesson was cancelled or a payment taken in error, the refund happens here.
refunds.note: A refund is written as a NEW entry and the original payment stays visible. Nothing is erased — so what was taken and what came back both remain clear.

commission.title: 5. Commission — you read it, you don't set it
commission.body: The platform's share of each lesson. This screen is in your menu so you know the rate in force while checking any figure.

how.2: See the global rate and any centre-specific rate

commission.note: There is no save button here, and that isn't an oversight: setting the rate is the super admin's. Ask them if it needs changing — and remember it applies to new classes only.

ledgerIsFinal.title: 6. The ledger is not editable
ledgerIsFinal.body: The most important rule in this job: an entry that has been written is never changed and never deleted.

how.1: Corrections are made with a NEW entry — a refund or an adjustment
how.2: The wrong entry stays visible beside its correction
how.3: If a figure looks wrong, look for its source rather than for an edit button

ledgerIsFinal.note: This is enforced by the database, not the interface — UPDATE and DELETE on the money ledger are refused for your account and for the super admin's alike.

security.title: 7. Your account's security
security.body: Your account sees the whole platform's money, so its security isn't optional.

how.2: Review the devices signed into your account
how.3: End any session you don't recognise

security.note: Two-factor is mandatory on your account — without it no screen opens at all.

finish.title: That's it — your turn 🎉
finish.body: The tour is done. Your day starts at “Payouts & disbursement” — that's where people are waiting on you.

agreements.terminateBody: New lessons stop settling under it. Money already settled is untouched.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The append-only money ledger. Every row here was written by a settlement, a payment or a payout.
transactions.deniedBody: Your account is not permitted to read the ledger.

financeReports.title: Reports
financeReports.description: Read-only views over the same ledger the screens use — no report re-derives its own totals.
financeReports.periodHint: Leave both empty for all time.
financeReports.idHint: Paste the id from the centre or teacher screen.
financeReports.enterId: Enter an id to run the statement.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Receipts and statements already issued, with their PDF.
invoices.sendEmailBody: The invoice is sent to the address on the account. This leaves the platform and cannot be recalled.
invoices.emptyBody: Invoices appear here once they are issued.

accountants.addBody: The account can reach the finance portal only. The role is set by the server — this form cannot create a super admin.
accountants.name: Name
accountants.passwordHint: Give it to them in person or over a channel you trust; they can change it after signing in.

notificationsHistory.title: Notification log
notificationsHistory.description: Everything the platform has sent, newest first.
notificationsHistory.emptyBody: Notifications appear here as the platform sends them.
notificationsHistory.deniedBody: Your account is not permitted to read the notification log.
